business_uid.description: The business the allowance belongs to (e.g., "ixfxpxc7s7shyf0m")

period.description: How the allowance renews. **monthly**: resets every month on the day of the month the subscription was created; **life_long**: a pack that never resets (e.g., "monthly")

unlimited.description: The allowance has no cap. Usage is still counted, and credit and left are null, so check this flag rather than a special value (e.g., false)

credit.description: The units the allowance grants per period; null when unlimited (e.g., 300000)

consumed.description: The units used in the current period (e.g., 96000)

left.description: credit minus consumed; negative after an overdraw. Null when unlimited, which is never reported as -1 (e.g., 204000)

resets_at.description: When a monthly allowance starts its next period; null for life_long (e.g., "2026-10-10T00:00:00Z")

expires_at.description: When a life_long pack expires, if it does; null for monthly (e.g., "2027-02-01T00:00:00Z")

description: A quota balance is the state of one allowance subscription of a business in its current period: what it grants, what was used and what is left. There is one row per allowance and never one combined number; add up the rows of a SKU to know whether the business can still consume it.
